purpose: Teach: 電卓/めまい/日課/美徳/二次会/失恋/老婆/バルト

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の経理、本気で、絶対、電卓、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、お手伝いしたいわ
lines.en: Aoi, I really want to help you with the store's accounting. Absolutely.
lines.style: Warm, direct, and earnest. Opens with gentle insistence. Soft but firm conviction underneath. Like she's offering something she's been holding onto.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、めまい、絶対、しちゃうことが、絶対、あるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah. Though I have to admit, sometimes the numbers make me a little dizzy.
lines.style: Self-deprecating laugh underneath. Honest without complaint. Half-sheepish, half-rueful. She's not looking for reassurance, just being real.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、朝のコーヒー、絶対、メイちゃんの、絶対、日課、絶対、なのよ
lines.en: Your morning coffee is part of my daily ritual, you know. It's that important to me.
lines.style: Quiet, almost contemplative. Speaks as if sharing something tender and true. Steady pace. The simplicity of the statement carries its own weight.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お客様への、本気で、絶対、丁寧な対応、絶対、葵にとって、絶対、美徳、絶対、よ、メイちゃん
lines.en: But treating customers with care — that's something that really matters to me too. It's a kind of virtue.
lines.style: Thoughtful, a little more composed. Not defensive, but clarifying what she values. Deliberate emphasis on 'matters to me.' She's not apologizing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお祝いの、本気で、絶対、二次会、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、参加したいわ
lines.en: I'd really love to come to the after-party for your celebration. Let me be there.
lines.style: Bright, animated, eager. The energy shifts lighter. There's a lift in the vocal line. She's asking, but with the confidence of someone who knows the answer already.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お客様、本気で、絶対、失恋、絶対、相談で、絶対、葵のお店、絶対、来てくれるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, customers come to my shop when they've had their hearts broken. They trust me with that. That means something.
lines.style: Reflective, grounded. Speaking from quiet certainty. Not proud, but aware. A pause-worthy moment. She's telling Mei something she doesn't often say out loud.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお客様の中に、本気で、絶対、優しい、絶対、老婆、絶対、いらっしゃるわよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: There's this kind old woman among your regular customers, isn't there? I've noticed her too.
lines.style: Tender, noticing. Soft opening. The recognition of something gentle shared between them. She's speaking to Mei's attentiveness, mirroring it back.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、バルト、絶対、海、絶対、いつか、絶対、旅行したいよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: But someday, I'd love to travel somewhere far — the Baltic, maybe. See the sea with new eyes.
lines.style: Dreaming out loud, almost wistful. Slight lift at the end, hopeful rather than resigned. She's been thinking about this. It's both a confession and an invitation.
